rule2.even-subalgebra-one-dimensional-ex:
"""rule2.even-subalgebra-one-dimensional-extension: exact checks.

For every nondegenerate (p,q) with 1 <= p + q <= 5 and nu adjoined orthogonally (index n = p + q):
(1) nu^2 = -1: the images e_i nu square to e_i^2 and anticommute pairwise, so e_i -> e_i nu extends
to a homomorphism Cl(p,q) -> Cl(p,q+1); the images are even and the 2^n ordered products of them
span a space of dimension 2^n = dim Cl^0(p,q+1), so the map is an isomorphism onto Cl^0(p,q+1).
(2) nu^2 = +1: the images square to -e_i^2 (the relations of Cl(q,p)) and the same span argument
gives Cl(q,p) = Cl^0(p+1,q).
"""
from fractions import Fraction as F
from itertools import combinations
import GA


def images_data(p, q, nu_sq):
    n = p + q
    sq = GA.sig(p, q) + (nu_sq,)
    nu = GA.gen(n)
    imgs = [GA.mul(GA.gen(i), nu, sq) for i in range(n)]
    return n, sq, imgs


def relations_hold(imgs, sq, target):
    n = len(imgs)
    ok = all(GA.eq(GA.mul(imgs[i], imgs[i], sq), GA.sc(target[i])) for i in range(n))
    ok = ok and all(GA.anticommutes(imgs[i], imgs[j], sq) for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, n))
    return ok


def span_of_products(imgs, sq, nbig):
    prods = []
    for k in range(len(imgs) + 1):
        for S in combinations(range(len(imgs)), k):
            x = GA.sc(1)
            for i in S:
                x = GA.mul(x, imgs[i], sq)
            prods.append(x)
    even = all(len(b) % 2 == 0 for x in prods for b in x)
    bl = GA.all_blades(nbig)
    return even, GA.rank_of_vectors([[x.get(b, F(0)) for b in bl] for x in prods])


def even_dim(nbig):
    return sum(1 for b in GA.all_blades(nbig) if len(b) % 2 == 0)


def check_spacelike_nu_gives_cl_pq():
    ok = True
    cases = 0
    for n in range(1, 6):
        for p in range(n + 1):
            q = n - p
            n_, sq, imgs = images_data(p, q, -1)
            ok = ok and relations_hold(imgs, sq, GA.sig(p, q))
            even, r = span_of_products(imgs, sq, n + 1)
            ok = ok and even and r == 2 ** n and even_dim(n + 1) == 2 ** n
            cases += 1
    ok = ok and cases == 20
    GA.check("nu^2 = -1: e_i -> e_i nu is an isomorphism Cl(p,q) -> Cl^0(p,q+1), all p + q <= 5", ok)
    return ok


def check_timelike_nu_gives_cl_qp():
    ok = True
    for n in range(1, 6):
        for p in range(n + 1):
            q = n - p
            n_, sq, imgs = images_data(p, q, 1)
            # relations of Cl(q,p): squares -e_i^2
            ok = ok and relations_hold(imgs, sq, tuple(-s for s in GA.sig(p, q)))
            ok = ok and not relations_hold(imgs, sq, GA.sig(p, q)) if p > 0 else ok
            even, r = span_of_products(imgs, sq, n + 1)
            ok = ok and even and r == 2 ** n
    # one explicit instance: in Cl(2,1) (nu = e2, square -1) and Cl(3,0) (nu = e2, square +1)
    sq = GA.sig(2, 1)
    ok = ok and GA.mul(GA.mul(GA.gen(0), GA.gen(2), sq), GA.mul(GA.gen(0), GA.gen(2), sq), sq) == GA.sc(1)
    sq = GA.sig(3, 0)
    ok = ok and GA.mul(GA.mul(GA.gen(0), GA.gen(2), sq), GA.mul(GA.gen(0), GA.gen(2), sq), sq) == GA.sc(-1)
    GA.check("nu^2 = +1: e_i -> e_i nu is an isomorphism Cl(q,p) -> Cl^0(p+1,q), all p + q <= 5", ok)
    return ok
rule2.imported-classification-centre-typ:
"""rule2.imported-classification-centre-type-c: exact checks.

Every clause is tested on all signatures (p, q) with 1 <= n = p + q <= 8 (44 signatures):
  (1) n even: Cl(p,q) is semisimple (the trace form tau(xy), tau the scalar part, is diagonal in the
      blade basis with entries +-1; tau is 2^-n times the regular trace, which vanishes on
      nilpotents, so the radical lies in the kernel of the nondegenerate tau and is zero) and its
      centre is R (the commutator with e_i sends distinct blades to distinct blades, so the centre
      is spanned by the central blades, and only 1 is central); semisimple with centre a field
      means simple;
  (2) n odd: omega is central, omega^2 = (-1)^(n(n-1)/2) (-1)^q, the centre is span{1, omega},
      isomorphic to R + R (orthogonal idempotents (1 +- omega)/2) when omega^2 = +1 and to C
      (omega^2 = -1) otherwise;
  (3) central idempotents: (a + b omega)^2 = (a^2 + s b^2) + 2ab omega (s = omega^2, checked as a
      polynomial identity on a 3 x 3 grid of (a, b)), so the nontrivial ones solve 2ab = b,
      a^2 + s b^2 = a, b != 0, i.e. a = 1/2, b^2 = 1/(4s): real solutions exactly when s = +1 and n
      odd, i.e. p - q = 1 mod 4, and then exactly eps_+- = (1 +- omega)/2;
  (4) the grade involution exchanges eps_+ and eps_-, while every inner automorphism fixes them
      (they are central; tested also on explicit invertible u), so it is outer; each ideal
      eps_+- Cl(p,q) has dimension 2^(n-1) and centre R eps_+- (a field), hence is simple.
"""
from fractions import Fraction as F

import GA
from tp_premise import premise


def sigs(nmax):
    return [(p, n - p) for n in range(1, nmax + 1) for p in range(n + 1)]


def central_blades(n, sq):
    return [b for b in GA.all_blades(n)
            if all(GA.commutes(GA.gen(i), {b: F(1)}, sq) for i in range(n))]


def semisimple(n, sq):
    blades = GA.all_blades(n)
    diag = all(GA.mul({b: F(1)}, {b: F(1)}, sq) in ({(): F(1)}, {(): F(-1)}) for b in blades)
    # tau(e_I e_J) = 0 for I != J: e_I e_J is a nonscalar blade
    off = all(() not in GA.mul({a: F(1)}, {b: F(1)}, sq) for a in blades for b in blades if a != b)
    return diag and off


def rank(elems, blades):
    rows = [[x.get(b, F(0)) for b in blades] for x in elems if x]
    return GA.field_rank(rows) if rows else 0


def check_even_simple_with_centre_r():
    premise("transport.centre")
    premise("transport.classification-real-clifford-algebras")
    ok = True
    count = 0
    for k in range(1, 5):
        n = 2 * k
        for p in range(n + 1):
            sq = GA.sig(p, n - p)
            ok = ok and central_blades(n, sq) == [()] and semisimple(n, sq)
            count += 1
    ok = ok and count == 24
    GA.check("n even: Cl(p,q) semisimple with centre R, hence simple (2 <= n <= 8)", ok)
    return ok


def check_odd_centre_and_square():
    premise("transport.centre")
    premise("transport.sign")
    ok = True
    count = 0
    nsplit = 0
    for p, q in sigs(8):
        n = p + q
        if n % 2 == 0:
            continue
        sq = GA.sig(p, q)
        omega = {tuple(range(n)): F(1)}
        ok = ok and central_blades(n, sq) == [(), tuple(range(n))]
        s = (-1) ** (n * (n - 1) // 2) * (-1) ** q
        ok = ok and GA.eq(GA.mul(omega, omega, sq), GA.sc(s))
        if s == 1:
            ep = GA.scal(F(1, 2), GA.add(GA.sc(1), omega))
            em = GA.scal(F(1, 2), GA.sub(GA.sc(1), omega))
            # R + R: two orthogonal idempotents spanning the centre
            ok = ok and GA.eq(GA.mul(ep, ep, sq), ep) and GA.is_zero(GA.mul(ep, em, sq))
            ok = ok and GA.eq(GA.add(ep, em), GA.sc(1))
            nsplit += 1
        else:
            # C: omega is a square root of -1, so a + b omega is invertible unless a = b = 0
            for a, b in ((1, 2), (-3, 1), (0, 5)):
                z = GA.add(GA.sc(a), GA.scal(b, omega))
                zb = GA.sub(GA.sc(a), GA.scal(b, omega))
                ok = ok and GA.eq(GA.mul(z, zb, sq), GA.sc(a * a + b * b))
        count += 1
    ok = ok and count == 20 and nsplit == 10
    GA.check("n odd: centre R[omega], R + R for omega^2 = +1 and C for -1 (1 <= n <= 7)", ok)
    return ok


def check_central_idempotents():
    premise("transport.existence-classification-type-c")
    ok = True
    count = 0
    have = 0
    for p, q in sigs(8):
        n = p + q
        sq = GA.sig(p, q)
        cb = central_blades(n, sq)
        nontrivial = []
        if len(cb) == 2:
            omega = {cb[1]: F(1)}
            s = GA.mul(omega, omega, sq)[()]
            # the polynomial identity behind the idempotent equations, on a 3 x 3 grid
            for a in (F(0), F(1, 2), F(-2)):
                for b in (F(1), F(-1, 3), F(3, 2)):
                    x = GA.add(GA.sc(a), GA.scal(b, omega))
                    want = GA.add(GA.sc(a * a + s * b * b), GA.scal(2 * a * b, omega))
                    ok = ok and GA.eq(GA.mul(x, x, sq), want)
            # b != 0 forces a = 1/2 and b^2 = 1/(4 s): a real b exists iff s > 0
            if s > 0:
                for b in (F(1, 2), F(-1, 2)):
                    e = GA.add(GA.sc(F(1, 2)), GA.scal(b, omega))
                    ok = ok and GA.eq(GA.mul(e, e, sq), e) and b * b * 4 * s == 1
                    nontrivial.append(e)
        ok = ok and (len(nontrivial) == 2) == ((p - q) % 4 == 1)
        have += len(nontrivial) == 2
        count += 1
    ok = ok and count == 44 and have == 10
    GA.check("nontrivial central idempotents exist iff p - q = 1 mod 4, and are (1 +- omega)/2", ok)
    return ok


def check_grade_involution_outer_and_ideals_simple():
    premise("transport.existence-classification-type-c")
    premise("transport.classification-real-clifford-algebras")
    ok = True
    count = 0
    for p, q in sigs(7):
        if (p - q) % 4 != 1:
            continue
        n = p + q
        sq = GA.sig(p, q)
        blades = GA.all_blades(n)
        omega = {tuple(range(n)): F(1)}
        ep = GA.scal(F(1, 2), GA.add(GA.sc(1), omega))
        em = GA.scal(F(1, 2), GA.sub(GA.sc(1), omega))
        ok = ok and GA.eq(GA.grade_inv(ep), em) and not GA.eq(ep, em)
        # inner automorphisms fix eps_+: explicit invertible u with inverse u^-1
        for i in range(n):
            u = GA.add(GA.sc(2), GA.gen(i))                  # (2 + e_i)(2 - e_i) = 4 - e_i^2
            ui = GA.scal(F(1, 4 - sq[i]), GA.sub(GA.sc(2), GA.gen(i)))
            ok = ok and GA.eq(GA.mul(u, ui, sq), GA.sc(1))
            ok = ok and GA.eq(GA.mul(GA.mul(u, ep, sq), ui, sq), ep)
        for sgn, e in ((1, ep), (-1, em)):
            ideal = [GA.mul(e, {b: F(1)}, sq) for b in blades]
            ok = ok and rank(ideal, blades) == 2 ** (n - 1)
            ok = ok and GA.eq(GA.mul(e, omega, sq), GA.scal(sgn, e))     # e omega = +- e
            # centre of the ideal: e Z = span{e, e omega} = R e
            ok = ok and rank([GA.mul(e, {b: F(1)}, sq) for b in central_blades(n, sq)], blades) == 1
        count += 1
    ok = ok and count == 10
    GA.check("grade involution exchanges eps_+- (outer); each ideal has centre R and is simple", ok)
    return ok
rule2.imported-completion-spacetime-alge:
"""rule2.imported-completion-spacetime-algebra-spinors: exact checks.

(1) The forced completion Cl(1,3) -> Cl(2,4): the conformal model exported by the
    transport.minimality check has signature (2,4) and the lifts are null; the transvection obstruction
    (a null rotation fixing v = e0 + e1 moves the pseudo-inverse w0 = (e0 - e1)/4) holds in Cl(2,4).
(2) The complexified Cl(2,4) on the Fock space of three ladder pairs: with Jordan-Wigner
    a_j, a_j^dagger on C^8 (exact Gaussian rationals), the six matrices a_0 + a_0^+, a_1 + a_1^+,
    i(a_2 + a_2^+), a_j - a_j^+ (j = 0, 1, 2) satisfy the relations of signature (2,4); the 64
    products are linearly independent over C, so the image is all of Mat_8(C) and the module is
    irreducible.
(3) Chirality halves: I_6 (product of the six) squares to -1 and equals c (-1)^N with c = +-i, so
    its eigenspaces are the even and odd Fock halves Lambda^even W, Lambda^odd W (dimension 4 each);
    the 32 even products preserve them and restrict to all of Mat_4(C) on each half (rank 16):
    each half is an irreducible Cl^0(2,4)_C-module.
(4) The real minimal left ideal: P = (1 + e0 e2)(1 + e1 e3)/4 in Cl^0(2,4) (e0, e1 positive) is an
    idempotent with Cl^0(2,4) P of real dimension 8 and P Cl^0 P = span(P, I6 P), I6 P squaring to -P:
    the left ideal is C^4 with complex unit I_6, which commutes with every even element.
The identification of the odd half with the conjugate dual of CS is not tested.
"""
from fractions import Fraction as F

import GA
from tp_premise import premise

QI = GA.QI


def _fock():
    states = [(a, b, c) for a in (0, 1) for b in (0, 1) for c in (0, 1)]
    idx = {s: i for i, s in enumerate(states)}
    ann = []
    for j in range(3):
        M = [[QI(0) for _ in range(8)] for _ in range(8)]
        for s in states:
            if s[j] == 1:
                t = list(s)
                t[j] = 0
                sign = -1 if sum(s[:j]) % 2 else 1
                M[idx[tuple(t)]][idx[s]] = QI(sign)
        ann.append(M)
    return states, ann


def _T(M):
    return [[M[j][i] for j in range(len(M))] for i in range(len(M))]


def _add(A, B, s=1):
    return [[A[i][j] + B[i][j] * s for j in range(len(A))] for i in range(len(A))]


def _scal(c, A):
    return [[c * x for x in r] for r in A]


def _mul(A, B):
    return GA.field_mat_mul(A, B)


def _eye(c=1):
    return [[QI(c) if i == j else QI(0) for j in range(8)] for i in range(8)]


def _gammas():
    states, ann = _fock()
    cre = [_T(a) for a in ann]
    gp = [_add(ann[j], cre[j]) for j in range(3)]
    gm = [_add(ann[j], cre[j], -1) for j in range(3)]
    return states, [gp[0], gp[1], _scal(GA.QI_I, gp[2]), gm[0], gm[1], gm[2]]


def check_forced_completion_of_spacetime_algebra():
    ex = premise("transport.minimality")
    premise("transport.no-go-level-elements")
    M = ex["conformal"](1, 3)
    sq = M["sq"]
    ok = True
    G = [[GA.dot(GA.gen(i), GA.gen(j), sq) for j in range(6)] for i in range(6)]
    ok = ok and GA.congruence_signature(G) == (2, 4, 0)
    for cs in ([1, 2, -1, 3], [5, 3, 4, 0], [0, 1, 0, 0]):
        Xx = M["X"](M["vec"](cs))
        ok = ok and GA.is_zero(GA.mul(Xx, Xx, sq))
    v = GA.add(GA.gen(0), GA.gen(1))
    w0 = GA.scal(F(1, 4), GA.sub(GA.gen(0), GA.gen(1)))
    u = GA.gen(2)
    R = GA.add(GA.sc(1), GA.mul(v, u, sq))
    Rinv = GA.sub(GA.sc(1), GA.mul(v, u, sq))
    ok = ok and GA.eq(GA.mul(GA.mul(v, w0, sq), v, sq), v)
    ok = ok and GA.eq(GA.mul(GA.mul(R, v, sq), Rinv, sq), v)
    moved = GA.mul(GA.mul(R, w0, sq), Rinv, sq)
    ok = ok and GA.eq(moved, GA.sub(GA.sub(w0, u), GA.scal(-1, v)))    # w0 - u - Q(u) v, Q(u) = -1
    GA.check("Cl(1,3) -> Cl(2,4): signature (2,4), null lifts, transvection obstruction", ok)
    return ok


def check_fock_module_irreducible():
    premise("correspondence.fock-model-complexified-ascended-algebra")
    states, g = _gammas()
    sqs = [1, 1, -1, -1, -1, -1]
    ok = True
    for i in range(6):
        ok = ok and _mul(g[i], g[i]) == _eye(sqs[i])
        for j in range(i + 1, 6):
            ok = ok and _add(_mul(g[i], g[j]), _mul(g[j], g[i])) == _eye(0)
    prods = []
    for b in GA.all_blades(6):
        P = _eye()
        for i in b:
            P = _mul(P, g[i])
        prods.append([x for r in P for x in r])
    ok = ok and len(prods) == 64 and GA.field_rank(prods) == 64
    GA.check("Cl(2,4)_C acts on the 8-dimensional Fock space of three pairs with image Mat_8(C)", ok)
    return ok


def check_chirality_halves():
    premise("correspondence.fock-model-complexified-ascended-algebra")
    premise("correspondence.spinor-identification")
    states, g = _gammas()
    ok = True
    I6 = _eye()
    for x in g:
        I6 = _mul(I6, x)
    ok = ok and _mul(I6, I6) == _eye(-1)
    parity = [[QI(-1 if sum(s) % 2 else 1) if i == j else QI(0) for j in range(8)] for i, s in enumerate(states)]
    c = I6[0][0]
    ok = ok and c in (GA.QI_I, -GA.QI_I) and I6 == _scal(c, parity)
    even = [i for i, s in enumerate(states) if sum(s) % 2 == 0]
    odd = [i for i, s in enumerate(states) if sum(s) % 2 == 1]
    ok = ok and len(even) == 4 and len(odd) == 4
    for half, other in ((even, odd), (odd, even)):
        rows = []
        for b in GA.all_blades(6):
            if len(b) % 2:
                continue
            P = _eye()
            for i in b:
                P = _mul(P, g[i])
            ok = ok and all(P[i][j] == 0 for i in other for j in half)          # preserves the half
            rows.append([P[i][j] for i in half for j in half])
        ok = ok and len(rows) == 32 and GA.field_rank(rows) == 16
    GA.check("I_6 = +-i (-1)^N: the chirality halves are Lambda^even W and Lambda^odd W, each irreducible", ok)
    return ok


def check_real_minimal_left_ideal_with_unit_i6():
    premise("correspondence.spinor-identification")
    sq = GA.sig(2, 4)
    ok = True
    I6 = {tuple(range(6)): F(1)}
    ok = ok and GA.eq(GA.mul(I6, I6, sq), GA.sc(-1))
    evens = [b for b in GA.all_blades(6) if len(b) % 2 == 0]
    ok = ok and all(GA.commutes(I6, {b: F(1)}, sq) for b in evens)
    b1 = GA.mul(GA.gen(0), GA.gen(2), sq)
    b2 = GA.mul(GA.gen(1), GA.gen(3), sq)
    P = GA.mul(GA.scal(F(1, 2), GA.add(GA.sc(1), b1)), GA.scal(F(1, 2), GA.add(GA.sc(1), b2)), sq)
    ok = ok and GA.eq(GA.mul(P, P, sq), P)
    blades = GA.all_blades(6)
    left = [GA.basis_vector_of(GA.mul({b: F(1)}, P, sq), blades) for b in evens]
    ok = ok and GA.rank_of_vectors(left) == 8
    corner = [GA.basis_vector_of(GA.mul(GA.mul(P, {b: F(1)}, sq), P, sq), blades) for b in evens]
    ok = ok and GA.rank_of_vectors(corner) == 2
    J = GA.mul(I6, P, sq)
    ok = ok and GA.eq(GA.mul(J, J, sq), GA.scal(-1, P))
    ok = ok and GA.rank_of_vectors(corner + [GA.basis_vector_of(P, blades), GA.basis_vector_of(J, blades)]) == 2
    GA.check("Cl^0(2,4) P is C^4 (real dimension 8) with complex unit I_6", ok)
    return ok
rule2.imported-rule-2-matrix-units-forgo:
"""rule2.imported-rule-2-matrix-units-forgotten: exact checks.

Built on the constructions exported by the check of transport.rule-2-ideal-fusion-sharp-form
(fusion(p, q, gamma): nu, omega, eps_+-, and E11 = eps_+, E22 = eps_-, E12 = eps_+ nu,
E21 = gamma eps_- nu as stated). Signatures p - q = 1 mod 4 with n <= 7 (ten signatures; the four
with n = 7 have 256-dimensional ascents), both signs of gamma.
(1) Matrix units, simplicity and Ad_nu: the 16 products of the stated E_ij, E11 + E22 = 1; the
    centre of B_gamma is R (central blades); Ad_nu = grade involution on every blade of A and
    exchanges eps_+-, which are non-central.
(2) a -> eps_+ a is an isomorphism Cl^0(p,q) -> eps_+ A: injective (rank 2^(n-1)), onto
    (eps_+ A has dimension 2^(n-1)) and multiplicative on all pairs of even blades (n <= 5).
(3) The two ascents are isomorphic, non-isometric: nu_+ -> omega nu_- satisfies the relations of
    Cl(p+1, q) in Cl(p, q+1) and fixes A; the signatures (p+1, q) and (p, q+1) differ.
(4) The null generator never fuses: for gamma = 0, J = A nu is a two-sided ideal (stable under
    left and right multiplication by every generator), J^2 = 0 on all blade pairs, dim B_0 / J =
    2^n, and the trace form of B_0 is degenerate exactly on J, so B_0 is not semisimple.
(5) One generator is minimal and fusion fires at most once: A itself is not simple (eps_+ is a
    nontrivial central idempotent); over all transport histories of length <= 4 from the 15
    signatures with n <= 4 (Rule 1 always, Rule 2 when the algebra has type C, type C computed
    from the blades: omega central with omega^2 = +1), Rule 2 occurs at most once, moves the
    residue by +-1 into {0, 2, 4, 6}, and Rule 1 keeps it.
"""
from fractions import Fraction as F

import GA
from tp_premise import premise

SMALL = [(1, 0), (2, 1), (0, 3), (3, 2), (1, 4), (5, 0)]
LARGE = [(4, 3), (2, 5), (6, 1), (0, 7)]


def check_matrix_units_simplicity_and_ad_nu():
    ex = premise("transport.rule-2-ideal-fusion-sharp-form")
    premise("transport.matrix-units-peirce-isomorphism")
    premise("transport.ascent-renders-grade-involution-inner")
    fusion, central_blades = ex["fusion"], ex["central_blades"]
    ok = True
    for (p, q) in SMALL + LARGE:
        for g in (1, -1):
            D = fusion(p, q, g)
            n, sq, nu, E = D["n"], D["sq"], D["nu"], D["E"]
            ok = ok and GA.eq(E[(2, 1)], GA.scal(g, GA.mul(D["em"], nu, sq)))
            for (i, j), Eij in E.items():
                for (k, l), Ekl in E.items():
                    ok = ok and GA.eq(GA.mul(Eij, Ekl, sq), E[(i, l)] if j == k else {})
            ok = ok and GA.eq(GA.add(E[(1, 1)], E[(2, 2)]), GA.sc(1))
            ok = ok and central_blades(sq, n + 1) == [()]
            nu_inv = GA.scal(g, nu)
            ok = ok and GA.eq(GA.mul(GA.mul(nu, D["ep"], sq), nu_inv, sq), D["em"])
            ok = ok and not GA.commutes(D["ep"], nu, sq)
            for b in GA.all_blades(n):

    return ok, base_sq
